newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Yields drop at latest Saudi treasury bill offer.
newsitem.headline: Yields drop at latest Saudi treasury bill offer.

text.p: Yields dropped at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of two billion riyals worth of one-month to one-year treasury bills, bankers said.

The yield on 28-day bills fell to 5.6750 percent from 5.6877 last week and the rate on 91-day bills fell to 5.7936 percent from 5.8334. The 182-day bills yielded 5.9206 from 5.9945 and the rate on 364-day bills fell to 6.1731 from 6.2517 percent.

One-month interbank deposit rates were quoted at 5-13/16, 11/16 percent, three months were at 5-15/16, 13/16 percent, six months were at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one-year funds were at 6-5/16, 3/16 percent.
The bills were priced at 99.56055, 98.55664, 97.09378 and 94.12500 respectively.
